step.name: defineUsersAndGroupsGenericClient
step.title: Define generic client user and group
step.description: Define a generic client with no password and group

step.name: defineGroupsGenericClient
step.title: Define generic client group
step.description: Define a generic client group that can be used to grant acess to
step.instructions: Submit rexx exec to execute step. The workflow is using the AUTOGID option to automatically generate a unique ID value in the OMVS segment of a group. If you cannot use AUTOGID, you need to replace it with a unique GID(group-identifier) for each ADDGROUP statement. For additional parameters, refer to the RACF documentation: https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/3.1.0?topic=syntax-addgroup-add-group-profile

step.name: defineUsersGenericClient
step.title: Define generic client users
step.description: Define a generic client user with no password that can be used for generating a client certificate
step.instructions: Submit rexx exec to execute step. The workflow is using the AUTOUID option to automatically generate a unique ID value in the OMVS segment of a user. If you cannot use AUTOUID, you need to replace it with a unique UID(user-identifier) for each ADDUSER statement. For additional parameters, refer to the RACF documentation: https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/zos/3.1.0?topic=syntax-adduser-add-user-profile
